subject: Problem uploading packages to shiny-server on AWS

messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Problem uploading packages to shiny-server on AWS
parts:
Hi,
 I've recently set up an AWS instance and got shiny server running relatively smoothly with R packages in place and some web apps
However, I now seem to be having a problem with packages from CRAN uploading but not unpacking
This is an example command which I believe is what I was using successfully until recently

sudo su - -c "R -e \"install.packages('dplyr', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""

I get the response that it will be installing packages into '/usr/local/lib/R/site-library' - where the other packages reside
but they get downloaded to a temp folder and just sit there

Any help appreciated

messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Re: Problem uploading packages to shiny-server on AWS
parts:
One suggestion is that it might be due to the fact that since I last installed a CRAN package, I have done something to the system to cause the problem
The first candidate would be that I installed git to allow me to install non-CRAN packages on github - a process which still works
Is this possible? If so, can I just do a command like

sudo apt-get remove git

without any implications?
